The {{PAGENAME}}, located on a hill north-east of [[Sweet Home]], was destroyed in the [[Great blast]], formerly the residence of the [[Inquisitor]]. The ruin is relatively unremarkable, aside from a grave in the back yard, presumably the resting place of the Inquisitor's wife. It is also mentioned by the Inquisitor that he had lost a child ([[Snake]]) in the fire, but was never able to find the body.

The grave itself doesn't appear to have much significance. Upon discovery, there is a damaged [[wooden marker]] and [[wooden grave fence]] pre-installed, which the player can repair, though with no known consequence.
